tim_output.campaign_summary: Beginning in January 2023, multiple nation-state APT actors exploited CVE-2022-47966 in Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus and CVE-2022-42475 in firewall devices to compromise an Aeronautical Sector organization. After gaining initial access, the actors deployed multiple tools (Mimikatz, Metasploit variants, Ngrok, PsExec, AnyDesk) to establish persistence, move laterally through the network, dump credentials, and establish command-and-control tunnels, while covering their tracks by deleting event logs. The investigation revealed overlapping TTPs across multiple APT actors using legitimate credentials and common commercial remote access software for malicious purposes.
